notes.note: Refs #3568 and #3575. Bounded display-note CSS review after the committed contract review. Replaced nonexistent --k-border with the shipped --k-line token, restoring the intended one-pixel border in both themes. Checked the shipped design token authority; the existing hosted undefined-custom-property test caught this exact defect (1 failed / 697 passed in source scans). Its focused suite now passes all 9 cases. Display admission, no-engine delivery, retention, error/retry and explicit-resend semantics are unchanged. Prior document classification and qualification limits remain; final controlled browser geometry is recorded separately in PR #4423.
